name: Game Stats
author: byo-pop
description: A STATS link on the game-over screen opens a page of the game's numbers: moves, swaps back, hints and undos with the points they cost, runs of 3, 4 and 5 with their points, cascades, the gems cleared per colour, the points per level as bars and the score over time as a line. An undo takes back its move's counts, and a saved game keeps them. Changes nothing in play.
